title: Special Topics in Documentary, Animation, Experimental Cinema, and Other Visual Media; Sound Design
description: Prerequisite: THET116 and TDPS201; or permission of ARHU-School of Theatre, Dance & Performance Studies department. Restriction: Sophomore standing or higher. Cross-listed with THET380. Credit only granted for THET380 or CINE319P. Students must pay a $25 lab fee.
